paite: Huan David tapa Solomon agamsung ah hatsak in a-om a; TOUPA a Pathian akiang ah a-om a, nakpi mahmah in athupisak hi.
heading: Kumpipa Solomon In Pilna Angen / (1 Kum 3.1-15)

paite: Solomon in Israel tengteng, sepaih sangkhat heutu, zakhat heutu, vaihawmmi, Israel gam tengteng a milian, inkuan a makaipen tengteng ahoupih hi.
Huchi in Solomon leh kikhawm tengteng Gibeon a mun sang ah ahoh ua; huai ah TOUPA sikha Mosi in gamdai a abawl Pathian biakna buk a-om hi.
Pathian bawm bel David in ana bawl khitsa mun, Kiriath-jearim a kipan David in alatou khin a; Jerusalem ah akoihna ding puanin azak khitsa him ahi.
Huan Hur tapa, Uri tapa, Bezalel bawl dal maitam TOUPA biakna buk chin ah a-om behlap a; Solomon leh mipite'n ava zuan uhi.
Huan kihoupihna biakbuk chin a dal maitam omna TOUPA ma ah Solomon ahohtou a, halmang thillat sangkhat alan hi.
Huai zan in Solomon kiang ah Pathian akilak a, akiang ah, "Bang ahia ka hon piak ding hon ngen in," achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon in Pathian kiang ah, "Ka pa David kiang ah hehpihna thupitak na langsak a, asik in kumpipa in na hon bawlta a,
aw TOUPA Pathian, ka pa David kiang a na thuchiam hihtangtung in; nang lei a leivui zah mipite kumpipa in na hon bawlta hi.
Huchi in hiai mipite ma a lut leh pawt a ka omtheihna ding in pilna leh theihna hon pia in; na mi hiai zahzah vai, kua'n ahia hawmsak thei ding?" achi hi.

Huchi in Pathian in Solomon kiang ah, "Hichibang lungsim na put a, sum-le-paite, hauhsaknate, pahtawinate, nang hon mudahte hinnate ngen lou a, damsawtnate leng ngen lou a, atung ua kumpipa a ka hon bawl na mite vai na hawmsak theihna ding a pilna leh theihnate na hon nget zawk ziak in, pilna leh theihna piak na hita hi.
Huchi in na ma a kumpipate'n ana neih ngei louh uh, nang nung a leng aneih het louh ding uh sum-le-paite, hauhsaknate, pahtawinate ka hon pe lai ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Solomon mun sang chin a kihoupihna biakbuk omna Gibeon a zin Jerusalem ah apai a, Israel tung ah yai ahawmta hi.
heading: Kumpipa Solomon Thilhihtheihna Leh Hauhsakna / (1 Kum 10.26-29)

paite: Huan Solomon in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite akaikhawm a; kangtalai sangkhat-le-zali leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei a, huaite kangtalai koihna khuate leh Jerusalem a kumpipa omnate ah akoih hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Jerusalem ah suangtum bang mai in dangka-eng leh dangkasikte akoih a, sidar singte leng phaizang a theipi sing bang a tam in akoih lai hi.
Solomon neih sakolte, Aigupta gam a kipan a lakkhiak ahi a; kumpipa sumsin mite'n huaite ahonhon in akhak zel ua, ahon a lei zel ahi.

Aiguptate gam a kangtalaite bel dangkasik shekel zaguk zel in aleikhiaksak zel ua; sakolte dangkasik shekel za-le-sawmnga zel in; huchi mah bang in Hitte kumpipa tengteng leh Siria kumpipate kiang ah leng azuaksawn zel uhi.
